open_points.subject: CLK-002 wall-clock reading scope
open_points.text: The normative rule ties the wall reading to an operation's own timestamps and current-time comparisons, but CLK-002 says without qualification that "an operation takes one wall reading"; the Required tests narrow coverage again to "time-dependent" operations.
open_points.question: Must an operation that writes no timestamp and makes no current-time comparison take one wall-clock reading, or take none?
options: Every operation takes exactly one wall reading, including health and other time-independent reads.
Only operations that write timestamps or make current-time comparisons take one wall reading; time-independent operations take none.
open_points.default_guess: Only operations needing an instant take one wall reading.

witness.initial: The service is running with a counting clock source and no state change is pending.
events: An unauthenticated caller requests the liveness endpoint.
outcomes: The endpoint obtains one wall-clock reading because it is an operation.
The endpoint obtains no wall-clock reading because it writes no timestamp and performs no current-time comparison.
witness.observer: A deployment test or host operator observing the counting clock source.

open_points.subject: CLK-001 required-test coverage
open_points.text: CLK-001 applies to "all portal-owned event timestamps written by one operation", while its Required tests name only activation, revocation cascades and bootstrap as multi-write operations; the tests for snapshot import, recognition intake, photo intake, credential issuance and payment recording require only preservation of supplied values.
open_points.question: Which Required tests demonstrate equal portal-owned event timestamps for every other multi-write operation, including expense intake, snapshot import, photo publication, credential issuance and payment recording?
options: Require a timestamp-equality test for every operation that writes multiple portal-owned event timestamps.
Declare activation, revocation cascades and bootstrap to be the complete scope of CLK-001's timestamp-equality requirement.
Extend the named source-supplied-time tests so they also assert equality of all portal-owned timestamps written by those operations.
open_points.default_guess: Require the equality assertion for every multi-write operation.

open_points.subject: CLK-002 required-test coverage
open_points.text: CLK-002 covers every operation's wall-clock count and forbids using the elapsed reading outside A25, persisting it, turning it into an instant or ordering it against a persisted record; the Required tests enumerate only authentication, revocation cascades, activation and bootstrap for wall-clock counts, exempt the audit writer's reading from counting, and for viewer entry assert only one elapsed reading, its boundary decision and absence from records written by that request.
open_points.question: What tests show the clock-count rule for all remaining time-dependent operations, that the audit writer takes exactly its one permitted further reading, and that elapsed readings are never converted to instants or compared with persisted records?
options: Add counting-clock tests for every time-dependent operation, an exact audit-writer reading test, and tests forbidding every prohibited elapsed-clock use.
Narrow CLK-002 to only the operations and elapsed-clock properties currently named by the Required tests.
open_points.default_guess: Add tests covering the full CLK-002 invariant.

open_points.subject: CLK-002 witness binding
open_points.text: The Required tests contain a CLK-002 item, but the witness line binds only CLK-001: "CLK-001 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal]; CLK-001 [witness: verification:staff_bootstrap_client_portal]".
open_points.question: Which existing witness check is bound to the CLK-002 Required tests?
options: Bind CLK-002 to one or more existing verification checks that assert its required properties.
Remove CLK-002 or its Required tests if no existing witness check asserts them.
open_points.default_guess: Bind CLK-002 to explicit counting-clock and source-policy verification checks.

open_points.subject: DEP-002 treatment of withdrawn OSV entries
open_points.text: The normative rule says a vulnerability is known only when "an OSV entry that is not withdrawn lists its installed version as affected", but DEP-002 omits that exception and forbids any vulnerability "listed in OSV for its version"; its Required test likewise says "a listed version ... does not start it" without excluding withdrawn entries.
open_points.question: Does an affected-version entry marked withdrawn in the OSV data read for this deploy block the deploy?
options: No; withdrawn OSV entries are ignored, as the normative definition says.
Yes; any OSV entry listing the installed version blocks deployment even when withdrawn.
open_points.default_guess: Ignore withdrawn entries and make DEP-002 and its Required test state that exception.

witness.initial: A built image contains distribution X version 1.0; the fresh OSV data read during deployment contains an entry listing X 1.0 as affected and marking that entry withdrawn.
events: The deployment gate scans the image against that OSV response.
outcomes: The image passes this entry because the normative definition excludes withdrawn entries and the service may start.
The image is refused because DEP-002 and its Required test treat a listed affected version as blocking without a withdrawn-entry exception.
witness.observer: The operator or deployment automation waiting for the service to start.
